revision_selection.objective: Select exact maintained source, target, and QEMU repositories and immutable revisions for the confirmed driver. Return only {repositories:[{role,url,ref}]} with one source, one target, and one qemu row. The controller derives platforms, envelope bindings, selection metadata, Git resolution evidence, and all hashes; do not copy those fields into the reply.

evidence_closure.objective: Select task-relevant evidence from frozen originals. Return {facets:[{lane,facet,rationale,repository_paths?:[{repository,path}],external_documents?:[{url,corroboration_urls:[url]}],external_urls?:[url],gap?:{impact,repair_trigger}}]}. Cover source, target, qemu, hardware, test and tooling; the controller adds source/driver_entry. Facet is a descriptive semantic name, not a hidden enum. Source/target/qemu lanes use their matching repository; test/source_tests uses source; other test/tooling facets may use any repository. Hardware cannot use repository_paths: keep implementation observations in source/qemu. For a hardware original, external_documents supplies a document URL and an independently published byte-identical copy; the controller downloads, verifies publishers, freezes hashes and records corroborated (not primary) authority. If authority or content is unavailable, use actually checked external_urls plus gap, never invent evidence. No hashes, revisions or material tables in the reply. On prerequisite repair preserve valid selections, add the requested originals, and address all reported errors together.

environment_recovery.objective: Establish the Skill's least-cost executable environment route using the frozen repositories and inventory. Reuse existing relevant tools, images and caches. Leave a self-contained environment-smoke.sh in cwd exercising the selected boot/device route with meaningful smoke oracles (version/help alone is insufficient). Run development probes as needed; the controller performs and records the acceptance smoke, so do not run a mandatory duplicate full smoke before submission. Write one Markdown report describing the selected artifact mode, commands, observations, failed alternatives and limits; distinguish observations already made from the controller execution still pending. No JSON schema or extra environment table.

target_platform_study.objective: Complete the embedded Skill's target-platform study using the terminal, the generated knowledge-base Skill, and pinned target originals. Return one complete Markdown work report covering the profile, target APIs, analogous path, knowledge-quality probes, gaps, and minimum target-change boundary. Use natural structure; there is no response schema.

source_closure.objective: Complete the Skill's source-scope and semantic-coverage phase in this task. First identify the required translation units from pinned originals and prepare working compile_commands.json in cwd. Request the SOURCE_ANALYSIS operation; the controller validates compilation, includes discovered local dependencies in the KB, extracts compiler facts and returns navigation. Then query selected symbols with knowledge c-facts (batch up to 32; calls/cfg details only as needed), inspect originals and finish ONE source report covering configurations, functions/callbacks, types, state, I/O, concurrency, lifecycle, errors and source tests. Expand compile inputs and repeat the operation only when needed; reuse valid facts. Missing local compilation dependencies are handled here, not by reacquiring repositories. End with the protocol's self-check after the facts support the closure; never interpret C from names or regex alone.

migration_contracts.objective: Complete the Skill's migration-contract and source-test-selection phases in one continuous planning turn, in that order and before implementation. Reuse the target-platform study and structured C evidence. Write ONE Markdown migration plan containing the behavior/safety/lifecycle contracts and the corresponding source-test triage/adaptation: retained intent, provenance, stimulus, oracle, boundaries, exclusions and evidence/inference distinctions. Derive only the smallest new tests needed to cover uncovered contracts. For each retained runtime scenario identify the actual supported guest entrypoint or command channel, peer/observation and required packaging payloads; establish feasibility from pinned originals instead of deferring the test channel to the final runtime gate. State genuine target/QEMU limitations without claiming unexecuted results. The controller exposes the same report as contracts and test-plan evidence; do not duplicate it into two documents or fill tool-owned hashes/tables. End with REPORT_PATH: <absolute path>.

driver_implementation.objective: Complete the Skill's Rust implementation, public test adaptation and pre-artifact compliance self-check in one worker turn. Implement the driver and only necessary integration changes; reuse the target study, plan and original evidence already inspected. Build/test incrementally and preserve working commands and evidence. Include the agreed runtime observability and test hooks. Review your actual changes against applicable target rules as required by the Skill; this is part of the existing work, not another agent, persona sweep or separate report. Return ONE concise Markdown implementation report covering decisions, source/test coverage, affected check results and genuine limits. End the report with DPF_SELF_REVIEW: PASS when current-stage requirements are met. For an independent second opinion on a specific residual uncertainty, include DPF_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW: <specific reason> in that same report. The controller records inventories and hashes; do not reproduce them.

artifact_preparation.objective: Prepare the Skill's runnable artifact in the writable target worktree using the existing build recipe, contracts and test matrix. The final artifact must launch every retained runtime scenario through supported guest entrypoints or command channels without rebuilding or modifying it; payload presence alone is insufficient. Package the self-checked driver, test dependencies and required observability. Reuse valid builds/caches. Resolve packaging/integration gaps here and self-check affected changes; do not defer known unreachable scenarios to public_qemu_validation. Preserve the prior implementation report for unchanged coverage and explain only the delta. If source/configuration changed, end DPF_SELF_REVIEW: PASS after affected checks; the controller refreshes its snapshot without another implementation turn. Copy the final artifact to .dpf-output/runtime-artifact. Create .dpf-output/check-presence.sh using supported artifact inspection to check the current driver, required payloads, and boot configuration/dispatch exposing every retained scenario. The controller reruns this checker. Resolve uncertain entrypoint reachability with a bounded packaging smoke; leave full contract execution to public_qemu_validation. Return one concise Markdown report with build/check commands, the actual scenario invocation protocol, evidence and limits. The controller owns artifact hashes and identity records.

public_qemu_validation.objective: Complete the Skill's public QEMU evidence ladder and final self-check in this worker conversation. Reuse the packaged guest entrypoint, boot recipe and frozen plan. Create .dpf-output/public-qemu.sh for the agreed causal positive/negative, boundary/recovery and repeated checks, returning zero only when required oracles succeed. Boot $DPF_RUNTIME_ARTIFACT unchanged; keep helpers/oracle inputs in .dpf-output/harness/ and observations in .dpf-output/qemu-runs. Run only needed development probes yourself, not an obligatory full duplicate suite. Write ONE report describing the harness and intended checks, ending DPF_RUN: PUBLIC_QEMU to request the controller's captured execution. On receiving controller_execution, inspect its observations/oracles and complete the Skill's final self-check in that report, ending DPF_SELF_REVIEW: PASS only on success. Do not rerun an unchanged passing suite for report edits. Fix harness defects here and request execution again; source/image prerequisites use the shared REWORK protocol. Preserve scope limits and genuine blockers. Independent second opinion is only for a specific residual uncertainty via DPF_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW.

public_repair.objective: Review only the risks listed in review_decision and their affected paths, not the entire migration again. Inspect the relevant source, callers, target guarantees and associated tests/runtime oracles against the frozen plan. Reuse valid evidence; run a focused check only when needed to decide a finding. Target access is read-only; write only ONE concise Markdown report. Cover all listed risks in this first pass and return all evidenced functional/safety blockers in one batch. For each blocker explain the requirement, reachable triggering sequence, violated invariant/consequence, original/code evidence and smallest resolving check. Static proof is sufficient; generic risks and unverified premises are questions, not blockers. Do not add style polishing, optional coverage, new requirements, extra personas or worker-owned tasks. On re-review assess fixes and affected paths, resolve worker counterevidence and retain closed findings unless code or evidence changed. Explain whether a new blocker was introduced by repair, exposed by new evidence or missed previously. End the report with DPF_REVIEW: PASS when no evidenced blocker remains. Otherwise put exactly one DPF_REPAIR_STAGE: <earliest actually affected prerequisite from the shared protocol> line before the final DPF_REVIEW: REWORK; choose the smallest affected gate. A trigger alone is not a defect.
